infobox.usage: Unlocks room 206 in the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 206 key (Dorm 206) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the two-story dormitory with a tag reading "206" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Operation Aquarius

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor of the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Bottle of water (0.6L)
- Aquamari water bottle with filter
- Water filter
- Canister with purified water
- Bottle of YMXC water
- Emergency Water Ration

These locations are found tucked between the boxes, inside and ontop of the wooden crates.

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Pile of meds x7; Pile of meds | → | Therapist; Therapist LL1 | → | Dorm room 206 key; Dorm room 206 key |
